about: Every key of the 15 vendor Malayalam keyboards (C:/Shree-Lipi nxt/*.MAL, loaded from their original paths) answered by S8MalU64.dll (TutorGetMappedCodeW, Unicode) and S8Mal764.dll (TutorGetMappedCode, Shree-Lipi 7 raw bytes; all seven installed SHREE-MAL7 / Shree-Mal7 faces have the same 189 codes on the same glyph ids: fonts/family-check.json; no 4/5/6 Malayalam face is installed). Two capture runs (capvo/, capvo-b/) were byte-identical; each run asked every key twice (#stable 1 on 13 keyboards; ENG and NEWROMA give #stable 0 - the second pass inside one process differs from the first, phonetic-mode state - but run A and run B agree byte for byte); every load verified in SLNXT's shared table (#loaded 1). layer 0 = printed keyboard (normal and shift are different ASCII keys), layer 1 = Ctrl+Space, layer 2 = the composer raw code layer (key char = internal code; NOT the Ctrl+Shift+1 symbol layer, which the tutor does not expose - see ctrlShift1). Per key: codes = the internal codes the key holds (a conjunct slot expanded, typed order), uHex/u = the Unicode composer answer raw / without its carrier, uRead = u in NFC, b7 = the 7 composer bytes. u null = no answer or a placeholder. Carriers to know: the Unicode composer shows a lone pre-base sign on a carrier ('.െ', '*്ര'); the phonetic keyboards (ENG, PHONETIC) answer a consonant key as C + virama, and their lone vowel-sign keys come back on the carrier byte 07 (no glyph in any face); the precomposed sign codes DC ോ DD ൊ DE ൈ DF ൌ (INSCRIPT/KERGOVT keys a ` w q, and others) make the 7 composer write NOTHING.

ctrlShift1.source: the vendor charts (CHM 'Special Keys'; assets/config/layouts/mal-*.json 'symbols': 16 of the 17 Malayalam charts list only $ = ₹, NEWROMA lists 14 keys) + the composers' answers for the internal code of each character (single-code probes, capp/P-results.json). b7 null = the 7 composer types nothing for that code; ₹ = 3C has NO glyph in any Malayalam 7 face.
